categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu HSC New Energy Materials Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, production, and sales of lithium-ion battery electrolyte additives and special organosilicon compounds. The company also produces hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite solution, and acetonitrile. Its main products include electronic chemicals such as vinylene carbonate (VC), fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC), lithium bis(oxalato)borate (LiBOB), and special organosilicon products like isocyanate silanes (IPTS and TESPI).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis technologies including UV-catalyzed chlorination for VC production and halogen substitution for FEC, avoiding hazardous fluorine gas. It has proprietary purification and continuous flow reaction technologies that improve product purity and reduce costs. The firm also develops advanced negative electrode materials using controlled fluidized bed CVD and organic molecule grafting techniques. It holds numerous patents covering synthesis, purification, and product formulation technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers and electrolyte producers such as BYD, Tianqi Materials, Mitsubishi Chemical, and Enchem. The end markets served are primarily new energy vehicles, electric two-wheelers, power tools, UPS power supplies, mobile base stations, photovoltaic power stations, and 3C electronics. The company serves both domestic and international markets including Japan, South Korea, the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Zhangjiagang, Taixing, Suzhou, Hubei, and Zhejiang provinces. It exports products to major overseas markets including Japan, South Korea, the United States, Europe, and Southeast Asia. The company is expanding its overseas market presence and supply chain capabilities to support global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu HSC operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, producing key electrolyte additives and precursor chemicals used by downstream electrolyte manufacturers and battery producers. It also engages in upstream chemical synthesis of raw materials and downstream sales and technical support to battery manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in lithium battery electrolyte additives and negative electrode materials, focusing on product quality, cost reduction, and new product development such as solid-state and sodium-ion battery materials. It invests heavily in R&D, holds over 135 patents, and collaborates with universities and research institutes. Future R&D emphasizes continuous flow synthesis, advanced purification, and development of new additives like HSI003 and LiDFOB.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of lithium battery electrolyte additives and special organosilicon compounds. The company sells directly and through distributors to battery manufacturers and electrolyte producers. It also earns income from investments and financial asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading supplier of VC and FEC additives in China, competing with firms such as Shandong GY, Fuxiang Pharmaceutical, Hengkang Chemical, and Shandong Furi. It holds a strong market position due to its technological advantages, product quality, and established customer relationships. The industry is highly competitive with price pressures due to overcapacity.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 505 million, a slight decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 174.7 million. The company has total assets of about RMB 4.29 billion and net assets of RMB 3.47 billion. Despite recent profitability challenges due to market competition and increased depreciation, the company continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu HSC emphasizes high product purity, advanced proprietary synthesis and purification technologies, and environmental-friendly production processes. Its products enhance battery safety, cycle life, and performance, particularly in high-demand applications like new energy vehicles. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and close collaboration with key customers differentiate it in the competitive lithium battery materials market.
